Watch what this spoon does
Wooden spoon or metal spoon?
This pot of pasta
is about to boil over.
Put a wooden spoon
across it,
and the foam backs off.
It is not pushing
the foam down.
Watch where the bubbles touch it.
Every bubble that hits
the dry,
cooler wood bursts.
Starch from the pasta
makes each bubble
sticky,
so they stack up instead
of popping.
The spoon breaks the top
ones,
and each burst knocks
out its neighbours.
But once the spoon
is hot and soaked,
it stops working,
and the foam climbs over.
